factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) and Risk and Risk Management (Page 30) detail programme delays impacting revenue and cash flow.

factual_claims.claim: The business was structured into two segments: Products and Missions, and Data and Services.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Review (Page 6) and Segment Information (Page 45) describe the restructuring into two segments effective Q2 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Net sales in Data and Services increased to SEK 80 M from SEK 45 M, with EBITDA rising to SEK 28 M from SEK 21 M, supported by operational milestones such as the Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 satellites becoming fully operational.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment Information (Page 45) shows Data & Services net sales of SEK 80,142 kSEK (2025) vs SEK 44,887 kSEK (2024). EBITDA: SEK 27,801 kSEK (2025) vs SEK 21,121 kSEK (2024). 2025 Highlights (Page 4) confirms Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 became operational in November 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Conversely, net sales in Products and Missions decreased to SEK 245 M from SEK 346 M, and EBITDA declined to SEK 17 M from SEK 52 M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment Information (Page 45) shows Products & Missions net sales of SEK 245,000 kSEK (2025) vs SEK 345,998 kSEK (2024). EBITDA: SEK 16,791 kSEK (2025) vs SEK 51,579 kSEK (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The report explicitly connects financial and operational variances to specific programme events and delays.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) and Risk and Risk Management (Page 30) detail how programme delays directly impacted revenue, cash flow, and order intake.

factual_claims.claim: Two programme-related delays materially affected revenue, cash flow, and order intake during the year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) states: 'Two programme-related delays materially affected revenue, cash flow and order intake in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: In one customer project, technical discussions between the end customer and a subcontractor delayed milestone recognition, shifting approximately SEK 32 M of revenue into 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) states: 'In one programme, technical discussions between an end customer and a subcontractor delayed milestone recognition, shifting approximately SEK 32 M into 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: In the EPS-Sterna weather constellation programme, political and procurement developments postponed project initiation, which contributed to an updated full-year guidance during the year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) states: 'In the EPS-Sterna programme, political and procurement developments postponed project initiation.' CEO Review (Page 6) mentions updated guidance due to these delays.

factual_claims.claim: Additionally, commissioning of the Sedna satellites took longer than planned, and the launch of the first two VIREON earth observation satellites was delayed due to rescheduling by the launch provider.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) states: 'Commissioning of the two Sedna satellites took longer than planned. Launch of the first two VIREON™ satellites was delayed through rescheduling by the launch provider.'

factual_claims.claim: To support strategic investments in satellite constellations and data services, the company strengthened its capital base through share issues and credit facilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) details share issues (June 2025: SEK 64.5 M; December 2025: SEK 50.3 M) and expanded overdraft facility (SEK 30 M to SEK 50 M).

factual_claims.claim: A directed share issue in June 2025 raised approximately SEK 64.5 M before transaction costs, and in December 2025, the company welcomed Bonnier Capital as a strategic investor through a directed share issue that raised approximately SEK 50.3 M before transaction costs, as part of an investment of up to SEK 140 M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) states: 'In June 2025, AAC Clyde Space carried out a directed share issue of 585,938 shares at SEK 110 per share, raising approximately SEK 64.5 M before transaction costs.' Also states December 2025 directed share issue to Bonnier Capital raised SEK 50.3 M before transaction costs as part of up to SEK 140 M investment.

factual_claims.claim: Furthermore, the company expanded its overdraft bank facility from SEK 30 M to SEK 50 M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) states: 'AAC Clyde Space expanded its overdraft bank facility from SEK 30 M to SEK 50 M to strengthen liquidity and support continued growth.'

factual_claims.claim: Total available cash, including the bank overdraft facility, amounted to SEK 80.1 M at year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (Page 32) states: 'Total available cash, including bank overdraft facility, amounted to SEK 80.1 M (70.8).'

factual_claims.claim: Subsequent events after the reporting period included an extraordinary general meeting in January 2026 approving the second tranche of the directed share issue to Bonnier Capital corresponding to approximately SEK 49.6 M, and the receipt of an order valued at EUR 76.3 M, approximately SEK 820 M, from OHB Sweden for the delivery of 20 microwave radiometers for the EPS-Sterna satellite programme, which contributed to an increase in the order backlog to approximately SEK 1.1 billion by the end of March 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 36 (Significant Events After the Reporting Period) states: 'An extraordinary general meeting in January 2026 approved the second tranche of AAC Clyde Space’s directed share issue to Bonnier Capital... corresponding to approximately SEK 49.6 M.' Also states: 'AAC Clyde Space has received an order from OHB Sweden valued at EUR 76.3 M (approx. SEK 820 M) for the delivery of 20 microwave radiometers... Approximately half of the contract value is expected to be recognised by the time the first six instruments are delivered by the end of 2028.' Order backlog increased to SEK 1.1 billion by end of March 2026 per CEO Review (Page 6).
